origin: User-provided local Jianying tutorial; abstracted principles, not a bundled preset.

route_semantics.typed: Supported technique.2.0 fields; build and validate an explicit graph.
route_semantics.recipe: Executable builder producing a typed graph.
route_semantics.workflow: Existing main workflow; separate confirmation and evidence remain required.

techniques.name: 横向或纵向调色前后擦除对比
techniques.intent: 通过移动分界线直观显示原始与调色画面的区别。

inputs.name: after
inputs.requirement: same source geometry and explicit source-time mapping

timing.rule: Both compared frames must refer to the declared same source moment for a true before/after comparison.

pitfalls: The wipe is mathematical; the proprietary grade is an independent asset_required dependency.
A normal transition between sequential clips can compare different source moments, causing object motion at the boundary; code should synchronize both streams when claiming before/after.
Source sample aspect15:16 differs from square pixels; normalize displayed aspect intentionally.
validation: At p=0/p=1 the intended full original/graded versions appear.
At p=0.5 both sides align in geometry and source moment.
Check boundary motion at several frames and verify horizontal/vertical direction.

techniques.name: 保留转场内部时序后再裁剪
techniques.intent: 缩短对比效果前后静止部分时保持擦除持续时间。

intermediate_codec.policy: lossless if graph nesting cannot be rendered directly

timing.rule: rendered t samples original effect at t+keep_in; effect progress must not be recomputed from the shortened clip duration

pitfalls: Repeated tutorial MP4 exports accumulate compression; retain a single graph or lossless intermediate.
Trimming source clips and trimming the composed output are different operations.
validation: The wipe completion minus wipe start remains unchanged after removing preroll.
Compare retained frames with corresponding frames of the untrimmed effect.

techniques.name: 音乐入点标记对齐变色完成
techniques.intent: 让听觉提示与明确的视觉事件同步。
pitfalls: Waveform or ASR does not prove the audible onset; this reviewer did not audition.
Trimming the head must preserve the marker's source-time identity.
Music library availability and permission are separate from the operation.
validation: Mapped marker equals the chosen visual event within one output frame.
Audition the rendered cue and check no abrupt cut or unintended silence.

unknowns: No audio audition or continuous playback performed.
ASR is unverified; exact filter name and final horizontal wipe duration beyond narrated example are not independently calibrated.
Exact original/graded stream alignment in the tutorial export cannot be proven from sparse UI frames.
